metadata.title: Supply Chain Runtime Assurance SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing runtime verification that deployed systems remain consistent with enforced supply-chain decisions, architectural constraints, and safety requirements over time.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP provides continuous runtime validation independent of supply-chain trust origination and enforcement.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Runtime Assurance SSPP ensures that software, services, integrations, and devices operating in production remain consistent with approved supply-chain decisions and architectural constraints. It detects drift, decay, and unauthorized inheritance of trust without relying on upstream assurances.

props.name: system-role
props.remarks: Validates runtime state rather than making authorization decisions.

props.name: trust-assumption
props.remarks: All upstream trust assumptions are treated as perishable.

props.name: decision-boundary
props.remarks: Runtime assurance must not authorize or deny actions directly.

props.name: non-equivalence
props.remarks: Runtime state must continuously match enforced policy, not historical approval.

props.name: forbidden-behavior
props.remarks: Long-lived or inherited trust without revalidation is forbidden.

system-implementation.remarks: Runtime assurance mechanisms verify integrity, configuration, provenance, and behavior of running systems. Findings are surfaced through evidence and telemetry and do not directly modify runtime behavior.

components.title: Supply Chain Enforcement / Gatekeeper
components.remarks: Provides the baseline of what was explicitly allowed.

components.title: Secure‑Resilience Alignment
components.remarks: Runtime protection and recovery override supply‑chain assumptions.

components.title: Negative‑Pattern Detection
components.remarks: Identifies forbidden architectures or behaviors at runtime.

roles.title: Runtime Security Operations
roles.remarks: Monitors runtime state and integrity signals.

roles.title: Platform Observability
roles.remarks: Provides telemetry, logs, and configuration state.

roles.title: Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines acceptable runtime states and drift thresholds.

roles.title: Incident Response
roles.remarks: Responds when runtime state violates enforced constraints.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls align primarily with NIST SP 800‑53r5 SI, CM, CA, IR, CP, and SR families. Runtime assurance focuses on detection, evidence, and notification rather than enforcement.
